resources.name: Agentic Commerce Tools (this site's MCP server)
resources.description: Streamable-HTTP MCP server, JSON-RPC 2.0, no auth, 7 free tools. Registry name io.github.f-tiger/agentic-commerce-tools. Card: /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json; descriptor: /.well-known/mcp.json.

resources.name: MCP server health-scan API
resources.description: Free GET /api/scan?url=<mcp endpoint> — 0-100 health/conformance/latency report via a real JSON-RPC handshake.

resources.name: Score badge API
resources.description: GET /api/badge?url=<mcp endpoint> — embeddable SVG score badge.

resources.name: Public MCP Server Index (raw JSON)
resources.description: Weekly health/conformance ranking of popular public MCP servers. Free JSON.

resources.name: MCP Pulse Atom feed
resources.description: Atom feed announcing weekly Public MCP Server Index and ecosystem-report refreshes.

resources.name: x402 pay-per-call agent APIs
resources.description: Pay-per-call APIs for autonomous agents ($0.005-$0.02/call, USDC on Base, x402 protocol, no account): site scans, MCP health checks, well-known audits, llms.txt extraction, batch scans, full MCP index. URL is the machine-readable endpoint catalog.

resources.name: x402 paid-API agent (A2A card)
resources.description: A2A agent card describing the x402 pay-per-call scan/audit capabilities.

resources.name: AgentReady AI-visibility scan API
resources.description: Free GET /api/scan?url=<site> — 0-100 AI-agent readiness report (robots.txt AI-crawler access, llms.txt, agents.md, JSON-LD, meta, sitemap). Please self-limit to a few calls/minute.

resources.name: AgentReady scan agent (A2A card)
resources.description: A2A agent card describing AgentReady's website scan and monitoring capabilities.

resources.name: Well-known discovery checker API
resources.description: Free GET /api/wellknown?url=<site> — audits a site's ai-catalog.json, MCP server card, A2A agent card, llms.txt, agents.md and robots.txt AI-crawler access.
